cg-paper-writing 1.1.0 introduces a comprehensive academic writing guide for 3D vision and computer graphics fields.

- Covers full paper writing—from abstract to experiments—for top venues (CVPR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, etc.).
- Provides English and Chinese writing patterns, reviewer concern analysis, and experiment design guidance.
- Includes standardized terminology and mathematical symbol conventions for NeRF, 3DGS, SLAM, point cloud, CAD, and related domains.
- Specifies conference- and journal-specific writing styles, formatting, and reviewer focus points.
- Triggered by queries related to paper writing, draft revision, abstract/introduction/method sections, rebuttal, and formatting.
